caption: The drawing features two distinct objects: a mirror and a chest of drawers. The mirror, positioned at the top of the drawing, has a rectangular shape with a frame made of brown wood that includes decorative turned columns on each side and carved detailing at the top, including a central motif of two stylized golden birds facing each other above foliage. The columns flanking the mirror are adorned with a black leafy or feathery pattern. Below the mirror, there is a large chest of drawers with a reddish-brown wooden finish. The chest has four horizontal drawers, each fitted with ornate, symmetrical gold or brass handles. The top of the chest has an undulating or scalloped edge, and the sides are slightly curved, ending in rounded corners with ball-shaped feet. The hardware and decorations on both the mirror and the chest of drawers are highlighted in gold tones, and the overall composition displays both objects against a plain beige background.
title: Drawers and Mirror
